name: R1: setup builds 30 cards, 4 per hand with 3 players and 18 in the deck (chance-free counts only)
rule_text: When the game is set up, the deck has 30 cards: for each of Red, Green and Blue, three 1s, two 2s, two 3s, two 4s and one 5.

name: R2: every card gets an ID, so the deck and hands hold 30 IDs in total (chance-free counts only)
rule_text: When the deck is shuffled at setup, the cards get the IDs #1 to #30 in shuffled order, and an ID never reveals a face.

name: R3: 2 players get 5 cards each and deck_count starts at 20
rule_text: When there are 2 players, each hand starts with 5 cards and deck_count starts at 20.

name: R4: 3 players get 4 cards each and deck_count starts at 18
rule_text: When there are 3 players, each hand starts with 4 cards and deck_count starts at 18; when there are 4 players, each hand starts with 4 cards and deck_count starts at 14.

name: R4: 4 players get 4 cards each and deck_count starts at 14
rule_text: When there are 3 players, each hand starts with 4 cards and deck_count starts at 18; when there are 4 players, each hand starts with 4 cards and deck_count starts at 14.

name: R5: starting tokens, fuses, piles, turns and final-round counter
rule_text: When the game starts, hint_tokens = 8, fuses = 3, pile_red = pile_green = pile_blue = 0, turns_played = 0 and final_round_counter = -1.

name: R6: with 4 players the target is 9, so ending on a score of 9 is a win
rule_text: When there are 2 or 3 players, target = 10; when there are 4 players, target = 9.

name: R7: after a turn the public state reflects the move (hint spent, turn counted, nothing discarded)
rule_text: When a turn starts, everyone is told the three piles, hint_tokens, fuses, deck_count, turns_played, the full discard_pile with faces, and the full hint_log.

name: R8: the active seat acts only on its own IDs, never on another seat's IDs
rule_text: When a seat is active, it privately sees the faces and IDs of every other hand, and only the IDs of its own hand.

name: R9: seat 1 then seat 2 act; seat 3 is not yet asked after two turns
rule_text: When turns pass, seats act in order 1, 2, ..., num_players, then seat 1 again, starting with seat 1.

name: R10: a legal colour hint costs 1 token and is logged
rule_text: When a seat gives HINT s X with hint_tokens >= 1, s is another seat and at least one card in s's hand matches X, then hint_tokens drops by 1 and the matching and non-matching IDs of s's hand are announced and added to hint_log.

name: R11: with 0 hint tokens no hint is offered
rule_text: When hint_tokens = 0, a seat cannot give a hint.

name: R12: no hint to oneself and no hint matching no card is offered; a legal hint is logged
rule_text: When a seat names itself in a hint, or names a colour or rank that matches no card in the named hand, the hint is invalid.

name: R13: a discard reveals the card to discard_pile, gains a token and draws a replacement
rule_text: When a seat discards an ID from its own hand, the card's face is revealed, it goes to discard_pile, and hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8.

name: R14: discarding at 8 hint tokens keeps 8
rule_text: When a seat discards with hint_tokens = 8, hint_tokens stays at 8.

name: R15: playing R1 on an empty red pile raises it to 1
rule_text: When a seat plays a card whose rank is exactly 1 more than its colour's pile, that pile becomes the card's rank.

name: R16: completing a pile with a 5 gains a hint token
rule_text: When a successful play brings a pile to 5, hint_tokens rises by 1, to at most 8.

name: R17: playing R2 on an empty red pile fails, burns a fuse and goes to discard_pile
rule_text: When a seat plays a card whose rank is not exactly 1 more than its colour's pile, the card goes face up to discard_pile and fuses drops by 1.

name: R18: invalid moves (hint at 0 tokens, self-hint, foreign or deck IDs) are never offered
rule_text: When an answer is unreadable, a hint at 0 tokens, a hint to oneself, a hint matching no card, or names an ID not in one's own hand, it is replaced by DISCARD of the oldest ID in the active seat's hand.

name: R19: each discard draws the top deck card into the hand, and the drawn ID becomes playable
rule_text: When a seat discards or plays and deck_count > 0, the top deck card is added to the end of its hand, its ID is announced, and deck_count drops by 1.

name: R20: giving a hint draws no card
rule_text: When a seat gives a hint, no card is drawn.

name: R21: drawing the last deck card sets final_round_counter to 3 with 3 players
rule_text: When the last deck card is drawn, final_round_counter is set to num_players.

name: R22: the turn after the last draw lowers final_round_counter from 3 to 2
rule_text: When final_round_counter > 0 at the end of a turn after the one that drew the last card, final_round_counter drops by 1.

name: R23: with the deck empty a discard draws nothing
rule_text: When final_round_counter has been set, no further cards are drawn because deck_count = 0.

name: R24: team_score is the sum of the piles and every total equals it
rule_text: When a turn ends, team_score = pile_red + pile_green + pile_blue, or 0 if fuses = 0, and every player's total = team_score.

name: R25: losing the last fuse ends the game with score 0 and no winner
rule_text: When fuses reach 0 at the end of a turn, the game ends.

name: R26: reaching 15 ends the game and all players win
rule_text: When team_score reaches 15 at the end of a turn, the game ends.

name: R27: final_round_counter reaching 0 ends the game (score 3 is below target, so no winner)
rule_text: When final_round_counter reaches 0 at the end of a turn, the game ends.

name: R28: the 40th turn ends the game (score 6 is below target, so no winner)
rule_text: When turns_played reaches 40, the game ends.

name: R29: with 3 players the game ends at score 10, which meets the target, so all players win
rule_text: When the game ends with team_score >= target, every player wins together.

name: R30: with 3 players the game ends at score 9, below the target of 10, so no winner
rule_text: When the game ends with team_score < target, the result is no winner.
